Insomniac CEO or a Detective Who Can’t Drive? Viki’s November K-Dramas
 The DANAMIC Team November 17, 2026 4 minutes read

 Rakuten Viki has two new Korean dramas this month, and they are polar opposites. What a Boss Wants , a romantic comedy, has been streaming since 11 November 2026 . The crime-action sequel Crash 2 premiered on 16 November . Viki says both are exclusive to its platform across Southeast Asia.
 One show is about a sleepless tech boss trying to build an artificial intelligence (AI) singer. The other follows a traffic-crime investigator who has an exceptional talent for reconstructing accident scenes but cannot drive. If you watch K-dramas on your phone during the MRT ride home, one of these will probably fit your mood better than the other.
 The Boss Who Never Sleeps
 In What a Boss Wants , Sung Hoon plays Kwon Do Hyuk. Nothing has eased his persistent insomnia or his emotional emptiness. Then his business partner betrays him, and his father demands at the same moment that he rescue a struggling entertainment company. Do Hyuk now has two problems and no sleep.
 His fix is very much a tech founder’s fix: he plans to create an AI-powered entertainer to turn the company around. The search for a muse leads him to Soo, a mysterious indie singer who looks strikingly like his latest AI creation. Soo is the stage name of Eun Chae, played by Oh Se Young . By day she works at a customer service centre, and her music happens on the side.
 After a run of awkward encounters, Do Hyuk discovers Eun Chae’s carefully guarded secret. He then uses it to pressure her into signing a three-month contract as his secretary. That detail is worth knowing before you start. The romance begins from leverage rather than a meet-cute, so viewers who find boss-holds-all-the-cards setups uncomfortable should go in with that in mind.
 The upside is that a forced arrangement gives the show plenty of friction. Viki promises clashing personalities, uncomfortable situations, and an attraction neither character is ready to admit to. The drama is based on the web novel of the same name by Sikeukeu. The person-with-a-secret-stage-life premise has charm of its own, too. Fans of the anxious guitarist in Bocchi the Rock! , which made our Fall 2022 anime picks , will recognise the appeal of a performer who keeps her music hidden from the people she sees every day.
 📅 Streaming since 11 November 2026 · 📺 Rakuten Viki · 💘 Romantic comedy 
 The Detective Who Can’t Drive
 Crash follows a specialised police unit that investigates insurance fraud, retaliatory driving, and suspicious road accidents across Seoul. Its hook is Cha Yeon Ho, played by Lee Min Ki . He’s brilliant but socially awkward, and he has an exceptional talent for reconstructing accident scenes. He is also the one person on a traffic-crime team who cannot drive, which is a wonderfully silly flaw for a man who solves car crashes for a living.
 He works with Min So Hee ( Kwak Sun Young ), a quick-thinking investigator with sharp instincts and serious martial arts skills. The team is led by the experienced Jung Chae Man ( Heo Sung Tae ). Automotive specialist Woo Dong Gi (Lee Ho Chul) and martial arts prodigy Eo Hyeon Gyeong (Choi Moon Hee) round out the unit.
 The newcomer for season two is Jisung from the K-pop group NCT. He joins the Traffic Crime Investigation (TCI) unit as its newest recruit, and Viki describes him as sharp and agile. NCT fans will want to start with season two. For everyone else, he’s a fresh face in a team that already works well together.
 Crash 2 key art, with its 16 November premiere date printed on it According to Viki, the cases range from staged accidents to deliberate acts of violence. In each one, the squad has to work out whether a crash was a genuine mishap or a calculated crime. Expect some comedy alongside the action.
 The smartest scheduling decision this month is that Viki dropped the complete first season of Crash on the same day as the Crash 2 premiere. Newcomers can start from episode one instead of skipping ahead and getting lost.
 📅 Crash 2 and Crash season 1 from 16 November 2026 · 📺 Rakuten Viki · 🚔 Crime-action 
 Three Older Favourites Return
 Viki is adding three well-loved older titles to its Southeast Asian library as well. From 20 November , viewers can rewatch Touch Your Heart , the workplace romance starring Lee Dong Wook and Yoo In Na. The same date brings Because This Is My First Life , a slice-of-life romantic comedy with Lee Min Ki and Jung So Min.
 That second one is the pick of the trio for this month. Lee Min Ki is the lead in Crash , so you can watch him go from a traffic investigator who can’t drive to a romantic lead without ever leaving the app. Touch Your Heart pairs nicely with What a Boss Wants for anyone who wants more office romance in their queue.
 For something darker, Signal is the acclaimed crime thriller starring Lee Je Hoon, Kim Hye Soo, and Cho Jin Woong. Viki lists it as part of this month’s library additions. Crash fans who finish both seasons early will have a heavier crime drama waiting.
 📅 Touch Your Heart and Because This Is My First Life from 20 November 2026 · 🔎 Signal joins this month · 📺 Rakuten Viki 
 Which One Should You Start?
 If you want low-stakes romance after a long workday, What a Boss Wants is already a few episodes in, so you can catch up over the weekend. Its AI-singer twist and double-life heroine set it apart from the standard office romcom, as long as you’re fine with a lead who starts out holding all the cards.
 Crash makes the stronger case for a long binge, because the full first season landed on the same day as the sequel. A detective who can’t drive is a better hook than most police shows manage. Starting from season one means you meet the whole squad before Jisung arrives to shake things up!
 Both new shows, the Crash catch-up, and the three returning favourites are on Rakuten Viki . Bookmark it, start the boss’s sleepless saga tonight if romance is your thing, and decide for yourself whether the singer or the squad keeps you up past bedtime!
